derivations.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

Map $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ to $\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis $i$, by $\Phi:x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$. It respects $x^S=1$, because $s_i\mid S$ makes every $x_i^{\mu_iS}=1$, so it defines an algebra map.

Now $\Phi(x^k)=1$ exactly when $s_i\mid\mu_ik$ for every $i$; as $\mu_i$ is a unit modulo $s_i$ this means $s_i\mid k$ for every $i$, and as the $s_i$ are pairwise coprime, $S\mid k$. So the image of $x$ has order $S$ and its $S$ powers are distinct; the target has exactly $S$ monomials, so the powers run through all of them exactly once. Hence $\Phi$ is an isomorphism and preserves [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md), because multiplication in each ring is cyclic convolution of coefficients.

Write $k=\sum_ja_jP_j$ in mixed radix, with digits $0\le a_j<s_j$. The axis-$i$ coordinate $b_i$ of $\Phi(x^k)$ is $\mu_ik\bmod s_i=\mu_i\sum_ja_jP_j\bmod s_i$. Terms with $j>i$ vanish modulo $s_i$, since $s_i$ divides $P_j$, and $\mu_iP_i\equiv1$ modulo $s_i$. Hence $b_i=a_i+\mu_i\sum_{j<i}a_jP_j\pmod{s_i}$.
Terms with $j>i$ vanish modulo $s_i$, since $s_i$ divides $P_j$, and $\mu_iP_i\equiv1$ modulo $s_i$.

Reorder the padded axes to $(a_1,\dots,a_d)$, so controls precede their target. Update targets in the order $i=d,d-1,\dots,1$, so no lower-index control has yet changed when axis $i$ is updated. Each update is a prefix-controlled cyclic shift of the valid interval $[0,s_i)$ and the identity on $[s_i,t_i)$, so zero padding stays zero.

Reversing all axes takes $O(d^2)$ adjacent swaps. Each swap is an equal-width [chunk interchange](address-interchange.md) of cost governed by a fixed exponent $\tau\in(0,1)$, plus a fixed number of linear passes if widths differ, so the map, its inverse and the padding cost $O(Tp\,d^2(1+\ell^\tau))$

symbols.name: convolution length
symbols.meaning: The length of the cyclic convolution, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: The Chinese-remainder address map rewrites a cyclic convolution of length $S=s_1\cdots s_d$, where the axis lengths $s_i$, $1\le i\le d$, are pairwise coprime and $d$ is the number of axes, as a multidimensional one, using only controlled shifts on tape.
